newsitem.title: INDIA: India ACC director steps down.
newsitem.headline: India ACC director steps down.

text.p: A prominent director of Associated Cement Companies Ltd (ACC), India's largest cement firm, has stepped down, the company said on Tuesday.
Darbari Seth, a long-time director of several Tata Group companies, had joined the ACC board in 1988.
"As part of his plans to reduce his corporate involvements, Mr. Darbari Seth has stepped down from the board of ACC effective from 14 August 1997," the firm said in a statement.
"Mr Seth had spearheaded a very successful and rewarding Tata investment in ACC in 1988 and was invited to join the ACC board," the statement said, adding he had contributed to the revival of ACC.
